Blocks.Section: Contextual Decoration with Social Actions
SectionPath: Contextual Decoration with Social Actions
Blocks.Text: We added this feature to provide more context for a given activity. This currently applies to only Comment activities. When a comment is made, we populate the siblingActivities with the previous timestamped sibling comments and parentSiblingActivities with the previous timestamped parent sibling comments fields if applicable. Both fields will contain up to 10 comments to provide more context on a given comment reply activity.
